author: Oscar Wilde
text: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

author: Mark Twain
text: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do…

author: Mark Twain
text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: What lies behind us and what lies ahead of us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams! Live the life you've imagined.

author: George Eliot
text: It is never too late to be what you might have been.

author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
text: If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden.

author: Ida B. Wells
text: The way to right wrongs is to turn the light of truth upon them.

author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
text: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power, and magic in it.

author: Aristotle
text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.

author: Plato
text: Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.

author: Socrates
text: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy, not on fighting the old, but on building the new.

author: Seneca
text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.

author: Abraham Lincoln
text: In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.

author: Benjamin Franklin
text: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: Be the change you wish to see in the world.

author: Confucius
text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

author: Lao Tzu
text: Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day…

author: The Buddha
text: There is no way to happiness; happiness is the way.

author: Kalidasa
text: Look to this day, for it is life…

author: Chief Seattle
text: Humankind has not woven the web of life…
